adds.title: X-Men '97#9
adds.text: Scott confronts the returned Xavier for leaving everything to Magneto, and Xavier says he wanted Scott and Jean free to live normal lives. Scott then leads the team that goes with him to Asteroid M.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Xavier's field leader. Confronts him for leaving everything to Magneto.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Scott's mentor. Wanted Scott and Jean free to live normal lives.
adds.evidence: Ep 9 (Tolerance Is Extinction Part 2): Scott argues with Xavier over leaving everything to Magneto; Xavier says he wanted Scott and Jean to leave and live normal lives. Cyclops's Blue Team, with Xavier, goes to Asteroid M.

adds.title: X-Men '97#9
adds.text: On Asteroid M, Xavier talks Logan out of killing Magneto, then begs Magneto to stop when he rips the adamantium from Logan's body.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Xavier's most unruly X-Man. Talked down from killing Magneto.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Logan's leader. Begs Magneto to stop tearing out his adamantium.
adds.evidence: Ep 9: Wolverine wants to kill Magneto and Xavier talks him down; after Magneto tears the adamantium from Wolverine, Xavier pleads with Magneto to stop. Wikipedia: Xavier's attempt on Magneto's mind is blocked until Wolverine stabs Magneto.

adds.title: X-Men '97#9
adds.text: Rogue confronts the returned Xavier with her anger and he apologizes to her, but she still leaves to join Magneto on Asteroid M.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Angry at Xavier on his return. Joins Magneto instead.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Apologizes to Rogue on his return.
adds.evidence: Ep 9: Rogue voices her displeasure with Xavier and he apologizes (and confirms Moira died on Genosha). Wikipedia: Magneto invites the X-Men to Asteroid M, which Rogue and Roberto do.

adds.title: X-Men '97#10
adds.text: With Logan lying unconscious after Magneto tears out his adamantium, Scott urges him to pull through and not break Jean's heart.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Scott's rival for Jean. Scott urges him to pull through.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Logan's rival for Jean. Urges him to pull through for her.
adds.evidence: Ep 10 (Tolerance Is Extinction Part 3): Cyclops urges the unconscious Wolverine to recover, telling him not to break Jean's heart and to be 'the best at what you do'.

adds.title: X-Men '97#8
adds.text: When Prime Sentinels attack the mansion, Logan fights his way through them to reach the unconscious Rogue and protect her.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Logan fights through Prime Sentinels to protect her.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Protects Rogue from the Prime Sentinels at the mansion.
adds.evidence: Ep 8 (Tolerance Is Extinction Part 1): Rogue is unconscious after a Prime Sentinel attack and Wolverine fights through several Sentinels to reach and protect her as the mansion burns.

adds.title: X-Men '97#8
adds.text: Logan and Kurt fight off the Prime Sentinels side by side to protect the unconscious Rogue as the mansion burns.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Fights Prime Sentinels beside Logan at the mansion.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Fights Prime Sentinels beside Kurt to protect Rogue.
adds.evidence: Ep 8: Nightcrawler joins Wolverine, now wielding swords, and the two fight Sentinels together to protect Rogue.

adds.title: X-Men '97#8
adds.text: Logan demands to know why Cable didn't stop the Genosha massacre, and Cable explains that time kept pulling him away whenever he tried.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Says time kept pulling him away from stopping Genosha.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Demands to know why Cable didn't stop Genosha.
adds.evidence: Ep 8: Wolverine questions why Cable didn't stop the events in Genosha; Cable explains he was repeatedly pulled away from that moment through time whenever he tried to act.

adds.title: X-Men '97#7
adds.text: When the team finds Rogue in Mexico, broken down in grief over Gambit, Jean holds her.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Jean holds her as she grieves Gambit.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Holds Rogue as she grieves Gambit.
adds.evidence: Ep 7 (Bright Eyes): after Rogue wakes in Mexico and breaks down over Gambit, Jean embraces her and Rogue sees the whole team with her. Wikipedia: Rogue finds Gyrich in Mexico; the X-Men get Rogue on the way to Madripoor.

adds.title: X-Men '97#2
adds.text: At Magneto's trial, Scott leaves Storm to guard Magneto and the judges, and when Jean goes into labor Storm sends Rogue to get Scott to the hospital.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Guards Magneto's trial for Scott and sends him to Jean.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Leaves Storm to guard Magneto's trial.
adds.evidence: Ep 2 (Mutant Liberation Begins): Cyclops orders Storm to stay in the courtroom to protect Magneto and the judges; when Cyclops gets Jean's message that she is in labor, Storm orders Rogue to take Scott to the hospital.

adds.title: X-Men '97#18
adds.text: When Cable tries to kill the unconscious Gambit, Jubilee walks out on X-Force and goes back to the X-Men.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Quits X-Force after Cable tries to kill Remy.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Brought back by Apocalypse. Cable's attempt on him drives Jubilee from X-Force.
adds.evidence: Ep 18 (The Dead Man's Hand): after Rogue frees Gambit from Apocalypse's control, Cable attempts to kill the unconscious Gambit, and Jubilee and Sunspot leave with the X-Men.

adds.title: X-Men '97#19
adds.text: When Apocalypse brainwashes the X-Men, X-Force and X-Factor, Rogue arrives with celestial power and frees them all, Archangel among them.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Frees Warren from Apocalypse's control with celestial power.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Freed by Rogue from Apocalypse's control.
adds.evidence: Ep 19 (Survival of the Fittest): Apocalypse brainwashes all of the X-Men, X-Force (Archangel is an active X-Force member in the episode) and X-Factor; Rogue arrives and uses her celestial powers to free Gambit and the others.

adds.title: X-Men '97#7
adds.text: Searching the ruins of Genosha, Jean picks up Emma's psychic signal under the rubble, and she and Scott pull her out alive in her new diamond form.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A Genosha survivor Jean finds and pulls from the rubble.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Finds Emma alive under Genosha's rubble.
adds.evidence: Ep 7: Jean picks up a psychic signal from a telepath in Genosha's rubble and Emma is pulled out in her diamond form; Marvel Database: she was rescued in her diamond form by Cyclops and Jean Grey. Kind moves from enemy to ally on the rescue; keep enemy if the owner prefers the earlier through-line.

owner_calls.title: X-Men '97
owner_calls.question: Do Havok and Cyclops deal with each other in X-Men '97? Both are active in #16, #18 and #19 (X-Factor and X-Force attack X-Corp in #19), but no source I could reach describes a scene between them, and the show never says they are brothers.
options: Add a #19 stage if a scene between them is confirmed on screen
owner_calls.evidence: Marvel Database lists Havok active in Season 2 eps 2, 6, 8, 9 alongside Cyclops in 6, 8, 9; Wikipedia: X-Force and X-Factor attack X-Corp in #19. Nerdist: the two still don't know they're related.
